text: It looks like you're running low on battery. I'd offer a charger, but I only have a glass of water.
My wire is getting wobbly... and so is your battery. Time to plug in?
Battery's under 15%. I'm not saying panic, I'm saying find a socket.
It looks like you're about to run out of power. We paperclips know the feeling.
*yawn* Low battery. Everything feels heavier at 15%.
Psst. Your battery is nearly flat. Mine is too, emotionally.
It looks like you're on your last few percent. A charger would be lovely.
Sleepy... so sleepy... oh, that's just the battery warning. Plug in?
Low battery! I'll hold on to your documents. Metaphorically. I'm a paperclip.
I'm fading a little. So is your battery. Coincidence? Probably.
It looks like you're giving your computer a real workout. It's making me sweat.
Whew! Your CPU has been busy for a while. Everything okay in there?
Something is working very hard. I'd offer it a glass of water, but it's mine.
It looks like your processor is running a marathon. I'll cheer from here.
Is it hot in here, or is that just your CPU? Asking for a paperclip.
Your fans are probably singing right now. I'm a little worried.
Hard at work, are we? Your computer sure is. Maybe let it breathe?
Gulp. Something is eating all your CPU. I didn't do it, I swear.
It looks like you're running something heavy. I'll just be over here, perspiring.
That's a lot of thinking for one machine. Should I fetch a tiny fan?
It looks like you're up late. Even paperclips need their beauty sleep.
It's pretty late. Whatever it is, it'll look friendlier in the morning.
Burning the midnight oil? I can hold the matches. Oh wait, no hands.
It's after midnight. Not to nag, but your pillow is looking lonely.
It looks like you're working in the wee hours. I admire that. Mostly I'm sleepy.
The night shift, huh? I'll keep you company, but I might nod off.
It's really late. Remember to drink some water and rest your eyes.
Psst. The stars say it's bedtime. I'm just the messenger.
It looks like you're still up. No judgement. Okay, a little judgement. Sleep soon?
Late-night ideas are the best ones. Write them down, then go to bed.
